content.comment_body: Is it possible to remove the SD card holder and reposition the connection pins on the outside of the device?
Yes, I have carried out this modification for nine years using [product_name] [article_no] from the first generation.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about removing and externally relocating the SD card holder and its pins on their device. Another user responded, confirming they have successfully implemented this hardware alteration over several years with a comparable [product_name] and [article_no], suggesting such changes are workable even if not found in official documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the SD card connection hardware can be physically moved and reconnected externally without impacting device operation.
